2608.03206.title: EduClaw-Bench: A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Pedagogical LLM Agents with Simulated Learners
2608.03206.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) power educational applications from tutoring to essay scoring, but each is a point solution to a single task, and only recently have these point solutions been integrated into agents operating over a learning management system (LMS). Yet tutoring is long-horizon, since a learner improves over days and weeks rather than in a single turn, and no benchmark evaluates an agent tutor across a sustained relationship. We introduce EduClaw-Bench, a benchmark that places an agent tutor in a continuous 30-day relationship with a simulated learner grounded in knowledge tracing (KT), whose knowledge-concept mastery, from a KT model trained on real-student data, drives its answers and is probed for learning gain across 55 scenarios. Each agent is scored on three primary axes (learning gain, responsiveness, and helpfulness) and two curriculum-design axes (Gagné and Rosenshine), with helpfulness and the curriculum axes judged by a cross-family panel of three LLM judges. Evaluating 10 agent adapters over three base-model tiers yields two findings that single-tier, single-session evaluation cannot reach. First, tutoring quality belongs to the base model and the agent harness together rather than either alone. Second, almost no combination sustains good tutoring over the full horizon. A calibration check ($\text{ECE}=0.049$) and a live-classroom field study confirm that the simulated learner and its measurements track reality. Our work is a step toward trustworthy AI tutors for future education.
2608.03206.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）驅動著從輔導到論文評分的教育應用，但每一個都是針對單一任務的解決方案，這些解決方案最近才被整合進運行於學習管理系統（LMS）上的代理中。然輔導是長期的，因為學習者的進步是以天和週為單位，而不是在單一回合中，而目前沒有基準能夠評估代理輔導員在持續關係中的表現。我們介紹了EduClaw-Bench，這是一個基準，將代理輔導員置於與模擬學習者的持續30天關係中，該學習者基於知識追蹤（KT），其知識概念掌握程度來自於在真實學生數據上訓練的KT模型，這驅動了其回答並在55個場景中探測學習增益。每個代理在三個主要維度（學習增益、反應能力和有用性）以及兩個課程設計維度（Gagné和Rosenshine）上進行評分，其中有用性和課程維度由三位LLM評審的跨家族小組進行評判。對10個代理適配器在三個基礎模型層級上的評估產生了兩個單層、單次評估無法達到的發現。首先，輔導質量屬於基礎模型和代理的共同作用，而不是單獨任何一方。其次，幾乎沒有任何組合能在整個期間內持續提供良好的輔導。一個校準檢查（$\text{ECE}=0.049$）和一項現場教室研究確認模擬學習者及其測量與現實相符。我們的工作是邁向未來教育中值得信賴的AI輔導員的一步。
